{{Quote|Jedi business, go back to your drinks.|Anakin Skywalker, to Rosha Vess and other clubgoers|audio=Anakin-JediBusiness-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Rosha Vess''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who was a member of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]] cult. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on Coruscant with her friends [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Immi Danoo]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. One [[Local day/Legends|night]] shortly after, she drank and talked with her friends at the club when Wesell went into the club to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The trio watched as Wesell was disarmed by Kenobi.

==Biography==
Rosha Vess was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|to]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She<ref name="DB" /> was a club-hopper alongside her friends [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Immi Danoo]]<ref name="SWI752">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> and a member of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]],<ref name="DB" /> a fast-growing<ref name="Complete Locations" /> female-empowering<ref name="Far Horizons2">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> religion fashionable on Coruscant during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWEZealots">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zealots of Psusan}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Vess and her friends were patrons of the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant,<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> at the same time as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. The two hunters were there preparing to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />

[[File:FaytonniVessAgira-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Vess and Agira turned to look at Wesell and Kenobi.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] shortly after,<ref name="NEC Note" /> Vess and her friends were once again in the club, drinking and talking with another Human near the bar when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pair of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered. The Jedi were searching for Wesell, who failed to assassinate Amidala earlier that night.<ref name="AOTC" /> The trio's fleeting attention was drawn<ref name="Coruscant Glam">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/10/imageattack20021025.html|series=Image Attack|text=Coruscant Glam}}</ref> by Kenobi as he [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when she attempted to ambush him, turning to stare as he did so. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the Jedi left with Wesell.<ref name="AOTC" /> Agira later left Vess and Danoo after identifying a club [[Unidentified weak-minded individual/Legends|patron]] for conversion to the Zealots of Psusan.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Personality and traits==
Vess was friends with Nyrat Agira and Immi Danoo.<ref name="SWI752" /> The cultist was ditzy,<ref name="SWI752" /> had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the Zealots of Psusan's<ref name="DB" /> starburst<ref name="SWI752" /> mark located on her abdomen, the same type as Agira's tattoo.<ref name="DB" /> The tattoo advertised her allegiance to the cult.<ref name="SWI752" /> Vess was considered beautiful.<ref name="Coruscant Glam" />

==Equipment==
On the night she visited the Outlander Club<ref name="AOTC" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note 2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she had on a black [[Clothing/Legends|top]] with a high collar, a black skirt, and a pair of silver heels.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|She has adopted the same type of midriff tattoo as Nyrat, advertising her allegiance to the Zealots of Psusan cult &ndash; or at least her willingness to accompany her friend to the body-art parlor.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="SWI752" />}}
[[File:Faytonni_ep2dvd.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Rosha Vess was portrayed by an uncredited extra (far right).]]
Rosha Vess was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Vess, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="AOTC" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, the character was first pictured in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Vess then first appeared in an illustation in the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]], illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> and released on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> The image of her in the book was taken from the then upcoming film.<ref name="AOTC" /> 

Vess was first given a name on [[October 25]], 2002, through the [[Image Attack]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Coruscant Glam" /> In the [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, author [[Daniel Wallace]] wonders whether Vess has the tattoo only due to her willingness to accompany Agira to get one. Wallace also states Vess and her friends' looks suggest the trio are the intergalactic embodiment of the [[Wikipedia:Valley girl|Valley Girl stereotype]].<ref name="SWI752" />

Vess at the Outlander, in pictures sourced from Episode II,<ref name="AOTC" /> were used in the background of the webcomic ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous|Rookies: Rendezous]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="rookies">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref> and published from [[February 6|Feburary 6]], [[2006]],<ref name="WeekOne">{{Blog|pablog|47|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week One Annotations}}</ref> to [[May 10]], 2006.<ref name="Week13">{{Blog|pablog|70|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Thirteen Annotations -- Finale}}</ref> As the pictures are repurposed and represent a gambling establishment on<ref name="rookies" /> the planet<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|116|ORD 1-2|Ord Mantell}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="rookies" /> around the year [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="rookiesdate">{{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}} states that ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'' is set around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> this article assumes the pictures do not constitute an appearance of Vess.
